data.one_liner: Official SBB design system mobile UI components and theming for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides official SBB (Swiss Federal Railways) design system components, color schemes, themes, and typography for mobile applications. It supports both light and dark themes, as well as off-brand variants.
use_when: You are building a mobile application for or related to SBB.
You want to enforce the official SBB design system and UI components in Flutter.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Material or Cupertino app without SBB branding requirements.
strengths: Pixel-exact implementation of the SBB Design System Mobile.
Built-in light and dark theme configurations with customizable color schemes and theme extensions.
weaknesses: Very specific to SBB branding, limiting its applicability for general-purpose apps.
data.setup_notes: Add SBBTheme.light or SBBTheme.dark to the app root MaterialApp theme configurations.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Google Material design components instead of the SBB design system.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Apple iOS-style components instead of the SBB design system.
